== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[FX-7 (Effex-Seven) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|FX-7 (Effex-Seven)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100682 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100682], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100682-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>fc744de305597622868aa19cb1ba442986c3f1179b866d388e48bb27095ce907</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
